title_en: Supreme People's Court Administrative Litigation Evidence Document Style (For Trial Implementation) (Continued)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Administrative Litigation Evidence Document Forms (Trial Implementation) (Continued)

Fa Fa [2004] No. 26

(Continued from previous issue) Form No. 10

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Regarding extension of time for evidence submission due to service by publication)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), because (fill in according to the specific circumstances of the case involving "the addressee is missing or cannot be served by other means"), this court is now serving the relevant litigation documents to the addressee by publication. The deadline for submitting evidence in this case is changed to ___ year ___ month ___ day. If evidence is submitted after the deadline, it will be deemed as waiver of the right to submit evidence.

___ year ___ month ___ day (Court Seal)

Explanation: This notification is served on parties other than the party served by publication.

Form No. 11

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing/Not Allowing the Plaintiff or Third Party to Submit Evidence in the Second Instance)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), due to ... reason, you have submitted an application to this court to provide evidence that was not provided to the court in the first instance.

Upon review, the reason stated in the application constitutes (or does not constitute) a valid reason under Article 7(2) of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court grants (or "does not grant") permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day (Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Article 7(2) of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. The notification granting permission shall be served on both parties and the third party. For the notification not granting permission, the people's court may orally inform the applicant and record it in the case file, with the party or agent signing.

Form No. 12

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Second instance specifying deadline for original defendant to submit supplementary evidence)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), (the appellant or appellee) needs to provide evidence to this court that was not submitted in the first instance due to a valid reason. Pursuant to Article 9 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, this court decides to specify that you shall submit the relevant supplementary evidence before ___ year ___ month ___ day. If evidence is not submitted within the deadline, it will be deemed as waiver of the right to submit evidence.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation: This notification is served on the original defendant.

Form No. 13

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Court organizing exchange of evidence by its authority)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), because (fill in by the trial judge according to the specific circumstances of the case where there is a large amount of evidence or the case is complicated and difficult), this court, pursuant to Article 21 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, decides to organize an exchange of evidence between the parties at (time) on ___ year ___ month ___ day at (place for evidence exchange). You shall be present on time. The deadline for submitting evidence expires on the day of evidence exchange. If evidence is submitted after the deadline, it will be deemed as waiver of the right to submit evidence.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Article 21 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. This notification is served on both parties.

Form No. 14

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing the party's application for the court to investigate and collect evidence)

( ) _ Zi No. ___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), you submitted an application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day to investigate and collect the following evidence: (name of the evidence the party applied for the court to investigate and collect).

Upon review, your application complies with the relevant provisions of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court grants permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification is served on the applicant.
2. The content of this notification may be orally informed to the applicant by the people's court and recorded in the case file, with the applicant signing or sealing.

Form No. 15

Decision of ___ People's Court

(Not allowing the party's application for the court to investigate and collect evidence)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), you submitted an application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day to investigate and collect the following evidence: (name of the evidence the party applied for the court to investigate and collect).

Upon review, this court considers that (reasons for not allowing the party's application for the court to investigate and collect evidence). Your application does not comply with the relevant provisions of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court decides not to grant permission.

If dissatisfied with this decision, you may submit a written reconsideration application to this court within three days from receipt of this decision.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This decision applies to the circumstances specified in Article 25 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. This decision is served on both parties and their agents ad litem.

Form No. 16

Reconsideration Decision of ___ People's Court

(Dismissing the reconsideration application regarding the party's application for the court to investigate and collect evidence)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

You are dissatisfied with this court's decision ( ) _ Zi No. ___ on not allowing the application to investigate and collect evidence, and submitted a reconsideration application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day. You stated: (the party's requests and reasons for reconsideration).

Upon review, this court considers that (reasons for the reconsideration decision). Pursuant to Article 25 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, the decision is as follows:

Dismiss the application and uphold the original decision.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation: This decision is served on both parties and their agents ad litem.

Form No. 17

Reconsideration Decision of ___ People's Court

(Revoking the original decision)

( ) _ Zi No. ___ :

___ is dissatisfied with this court's decision ( ) _ Zi No. ___ on not allowing the application to investigate and collect evidence, and submitted a reconsideration application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day. You stated: (requests and reasons for reconsideration).

Upon review, this court considers that (reasons for the reconsideration decision). Pursuant to Article 25 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, the decision is as follows:

1. Revoke this court's decision ( ) _ Zi No. ___ dated ___ year ___ month ___ day;
2. Grant the application submitted to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day by (name of the party applying for the people's court to investigate and collect evidence) to investigate and collect (name of the evidence the party applied to the people's court to investigate and collect).

___ year ___ month ___ day (Court Seal)

Explanation: This decision is served on both parties and their agents ad litem.

Form No. 18

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Transfer of evidence)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute concerning (name of the party and cause of action), pursuant to Articles 22 and 23 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, this court decides to transfer the following evidence to you regarding the matter of (state the matter): (state the name of the evidence to be transferred).

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation: This notification is served on the administrative organ, other organization, or citizen from whom evidence is being transferred.

Form No. 19

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Evidence preservation guarantee)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), you submitted an application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day for evidence preservation of (name of the evidence the party applied for preservation). Pursuant to Article 27(2) of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, you shall provide (specific method of guarantee) as a guarantee within ___ days from receipt of this notification. If the guarantee is not provided within the deadline, the application will be deemed withdrawn.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation: This notification is served on the applicant.

Form No. 20

Administrative Ruling of ___ People's Court

(Evidence preservation)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

Applicant (name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent (name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

In the case of the dispute in the lawsuit brought by ___ v. (name of the party and cause of action) being heard by this court, the applicant (name of applicant) submitted an application for evidence preservation to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day, requesting (state what evidence the party applies to preserve and by what method, and the circumstances of the party providing a guarantee).

Upon review, this court considers that (reasons for the evidence preservation ruling). Pursuant to Article 36 of the Administrative Litigation Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 27 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, the ruling is as follows: (name, quantity, and method of preservation of the evidence).

Presiding Judge: ___ Judge: ___ Judge: ___

___ year ___ month ___ day (Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: ___

Explanation: This ruling shall be served on the applicant and all parties involved or related third parties.

Form No. 21

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Dismissing the application for evidence preservation)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), you submitted an application for evidence preservation to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day, requesting (state what evidence the party applies to preserve and by what method, and the circumstances of the party providing a guarantee).

Upon review, this court considers that (reasons for the decision). Pursuant to Article 36 of the Administrative Litigation Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 27 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation (or other legal or judicial interpretation provisions may be cited), this court dismisses your application for evidence preservation.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notification is served on the applicant. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the party and recorded in the case file, with the party or agent signing.

Form No. 22

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing/Not Allowing the application for re-examination of the expert conclusion provided by the defendant)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

The party (name of the party applying for re-examination) has objections to the expert conclusion based on which (name of the defendant) determined the facts of the case, and believes that (reasons for the party's application for re-examination), and submitted an application for re-examination to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day.

Upon review, the application of (name of the applicant) complies with (or does not comply with) the provisions of Article 29 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court (grants or does not grant) permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Article 29 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. The notification allowing re-examination is served on all parties. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the parties by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with both parties or their agents signing.
3. The notification not allowing re-examination is served on the applicant. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the applicant by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with the applicant or agent signing.

Form No. 23

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing/Not Allowing the application for re-examination of the expert conclusion entrusted by the court)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

You have objections to the expert conclusion made by (name of the original entrusted expert institution or expert) entrusted by (name of the people's court that originally entrusted the expert), and believe that (reasons for the party's application for re-examination), and submitted an application for re-examination to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day.

Upon review, (reasons for allowing or not allowing the party's application for re-examination), your application complies with (or does not comply with) the provisions of Article 30 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court (grants or does not grant) permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Article 30 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. The notification allowing re-examination is served on all parties. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the parties by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with both parties or their agents signing.
3. The notification not allowing re-examination is served on the applicant. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the applicant by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with the applicant or agent signing.

Form No. 24

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing/Not Allowing the application for re-inspection of the court's inspection conclusion)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

You have objections to the inspection conclusion based on which (name of the inspection court) determined the facts of the case, and believe that (reasons for the party's application for re-inspection), and submitted an application for re-inspection to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day.

Upon review, your application complies with (or does not comply with) the provisions of Article 34 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court (grants or does not grant) permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the provisions of Article 34 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. The notification allowing re-inspection is served on all parties. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the parties by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with both parties or their agents signing.
3. The notification not allowing re-inspection is served on the applicant. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the applicant by the trial judge in court and recorded in the case file, with the applicant or agent signing.

Form No. 25

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Allowing a witness to testify in court)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party and cause of action), you submitted an application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day requesting the witness (name of the witness) to testify in court regarding matters (matters on which the witness will testify).

Upon review, your application complies with the provisions of Article 43 (or Article 44) of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court grants permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Articles 43 and 44 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. This notification is served on the applicant, but the application for the witness to testify in court shall be recorded in the evidence list or evidence receipt.

Form No. 26

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Not allowing a witness to testify in court)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between you and (name of the opposing party), you submitted an application to this court on ___ year ___ month ___ day requesting the witness (name of the witness) to testify in court regarding matters (matters on which the witness will testify). Upon review, (reasons for not allowing the party's application), this court does not grant permission.

___ year ___ month ___ day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
1. This notification applies to the circumstances specified in Articles 43 and 44 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation.
2. This notification is served on the applicant. The content of the notification may be orally informed to the applicant by the trial judge and recorded in the case file, with the party or agent signing.

Form No. 27

Notification of ___ People's Court

(Court notifying a witness to testify in court upon party's application)

( ) _ Zi No. ___

___ :

In the case of the dispute between (name of the party and cause of action), (name of the party applying for the witness to testify in court) has applied for you (if the witness is an organization, "your organization" may be filled in) to testify in court, and this court has granted permission. You (if the witness is an organization, "your organization" may be filled in) shall appear at (place for witness testimony) on ___ year ___ month ___ day at ___ hour ___ minute with valid identification to attend the court hearing (if the witness is to testify at evidence exchange, it may be stated as "evidence exchange") and give testimony. Pursuant to the Administrative Litigation Law of the People's Republic of China and the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Administrative Litigation, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. Any unit or individual who knows the circumstances of a case has the obligation to testify in court.
2. A witness shall objectively state the facts personally perceived, and shall not use language of conjecture, inference, or comment. A witness shall not read a written deposition prepared in advance.
3. A witness shall testify honestly and truthfully answer questions from the trial judge and the parties. A witness who gives false testimony shall bear corresponding legal liability.
4. A witness shall not sit in on the court hearing, and shall not exchange views with the parties or other witnesses.

V. The lawful rights and interests of witnesses shall be protected by law.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to circumstances where a court notifies a witness to testify in court upon the application of a party.

2. This notice shall be served on the witness.

Form 28

______ People's Court Notice

(Notice to Witness to Testify in Court Ex Officio)

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

______：

In the dispute case of ______ and (name of the party or parties and cause of action), this court now notifies you (if a unit is the witness, "your unit" may be filled in) to appear as a witness and give testimony in court on the matter of (matter for which the witness is to testify). You (if a unit is the witness, "your unit" may be filled in) shall appear at (location for testimony) at ______ o'clock on ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day) with valid identification to attend the court hearing (if the witness appears to give testimony at evidence exchange, it may be stated as "evidence exchange") and give testimony. In accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

I. Any unit or individual who has knowledge of the facts of a case has the duty to testify in court.

II. A witness shall objectively state the facts personally perceived and shall not use language that is speculative, inferential, or evaluative. A witness shall not read a pre-prepared written testimony.

III. A witness shall testify honestly and truthfully answer questions from the trial personnel and parties; a witness who gives false testimony shall bear corresponding legal liability.

IV. A witness shall not sit in on court hearings or exchange views with parties or other witnesses.

V. The lawful rights and interests of witnesses shall be protected by law.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to circumstances where a court notifies a witness to testify in court ex officio.

2. This notice shall be served on the witness.

Form 29

______ People's Court Notice

(Approval for a Person with Specialized Knowledge to Appear in Court to Assist in Cross-Examination)

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

______：

In the dispute case of your party with (name of the opposing party and cause of action), (name of the party applying for a person with specialized knowledge to appear in court) filed an application with this court on ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day) for (name of the person with specialized knowledge applied for by the party) to appear in court as a person with specialized knowledge to assist in cross-examination on the matter of (matter for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination). Upon review, the application of (name of the party applying for the person with specialized knowledge to appear in court) meets the requirements of Article 48 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court hereby approves it.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 48 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation.

2. For the consideration of procedural fairness, this notice shall be served on both parties.

Form 30

______ People's Court Notice

(Disapproval of a Person with Specialized Knowledge to Appear in Court to Assist in Cross-Examination)

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

______：

In the dispute case of your party with (name of the opposing party and cause of action), your party filed an application with this court on ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day) for (name of the person with specialized knowledge applied for by the party) to appear in court as a person with specialized knowledge to assist in cross-examination on the matter of (matter for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination). Upon review, your party's application does not meet the requirements of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation, and this court hereby disapproves it.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 48 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Litigation.

2. This notice shall be served on the applicant. The contents of the notice may be orally informed to the applicant by the trial personnel and recorded in the笔录, signed by the applicant or agent.

Form 31

______ People's Court Notice

(Person with Specialized Knowledge to Appear in Court to Assist in Cross-Examination)

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

______：

In the dispute case of ______ with (name of the party or parties and cause of action), (name of the party applying for a person with specialized knowledge to appear in court) has applied to this court for you to appear in court as a person with specialized knowledge to assist their cross-examination on the (specific expert issue for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination) issue involved in this case. This court has reviewed and approved the application of (name of the party applying for the person with specialized knowledge to appear in court). The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

I. You shall appear at (location of court hearing) with valid identification at ______ o'clock on ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day) to attend the court hearing.

II. You shall observe courtroom order and obey the direction of the trial personnel, and shall not participate in litigation activities unrelated to the (specific expert issue for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination) issue in this case.

III. Trial personnel and parties may examine you. With the permission of the people's court, you may confront the person with specialized knowledge applied for by the opposing party on the (specific expert issue for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination) issue.

IV. In court, you may question the expert evaluator on the (specific expert issue for which the person with specialized knowledge is to assist in cross-examination) issue.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 48 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation.

2. This notice shall be served on the person with specialized knowledge who appears in court to assist in cross-examination.

Form 32

______ People's Court Notice

(Submission of Opinions or Evidence on New Evidence)

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

______：

In the dispute case of your party with (name of the opposing party and cause of action), (name of the party claiming new evidence) has submitted new evidence to this court (name of the new evidence) in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation. Your party shall submit opinions or evidence regarding this new evidence by ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day). Failure to submit evidence within the time limit shall be deemed as waiver of the right to adduce evidence.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This notice applies to the circumstances under Articles 50, 51, and 52 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation.

2. This notice shall be served on the opposing party of the party submitting new evidence.

Form 33

______ People's Court

Evidence Receipt

(______) ______ Zi No. ______

Received today from (name of the party submitting the evidence) the evidence (for a single piece of evidence, the name of the evidence may be filled in; if there are multiple pieces, it may be stated as "see appendix") in ______ copy(ies).

Recipient: ______

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

Appendix:

Serial Number | Name of Evidence | Number of Copies | Number of Pages | Original/Copy | Purpose of Proof | Remarks

Note: This receipt shall be issued to the party submitting evidence materials to the court.

December 8, 2004
